scene: Turning the glowing page unfolds three balconies overlooking different city transit lines.
picture: Pixel art side-view. From left to right along a wide library terrace: a yellow bicycle rickshaw parked on a ramp, the tall Latino man in straw hat, red poncho, and guitar, and an idling purple night bus on the right platform. Up high above the railing hangs a docked, striped gondola.
